answer: Quadratic voting cost for identity registration resists sybil attacks by making each new identity exponentially more expensive. On this digital island, an attacker cannot spawn fakes cheaply; the cost for N identities scales with N squared. This beacon ensures that if a violet identity is affordable, mass duplication is ruinous. An attacker needing 1000 nodes pays 1,000,000 times the base fee, creating a concrete economic barrier against forgery.
